name: Kohinata Yuki
source:
The eldest of the three sisters. A modest and bright girl.
She is the leader of the family, and despite being a little goofy sometimes, she is firm and capable.

[Summarized from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=540965&aff=000626-01-00]Getchu[/url].]
